title: Two Essences and the Yes and Amen
description: The seal completed. T103 — the two essences from the beginning, what is given and what is claimed, the beautiful and the bitter, life and death: regeneration is the separating of the beautiful from the darkness, and at the end this separation is forever — many waters cannot mingle them again. T104 — the structural supports of the regenerated rational: the Great Mind, the inner image, twelve angels, seven pillars, the bound of love as wall, four bearing-up powers, twelve below, three great pillars, the Omophoros, the seeds in the firmaments. And the doctrinal close: the Yes and the Amen identified as the Calling and the Hearing — the soul's permanent answering, that which reigns over the whole work, gives the Divine Human into the conjunction of Father and Mother of Life, and refines, helps, and grants remembrance to the Living Soul. Many waters cannot quench love; the seal is set; the cycle is complete.
